_readme: Source for the three tutorial Word Wheels. Edit here, then run `npm run tutorials` to rebuild public/tutorials/wordwheel/wordwheel-*.json. `centre` is the middle letter and `outer` the ring (6 to 10 letters; a letter may appear twice). Each word needs four letters or more, must use the centre and can only use each tile once; the build checks that. `ranks` are the found-word counts where the progress bar's markers sit.
